title: Lumentum CEO warns of impending bottleneck on critical material used for silicon photonics — fab and material shortfall already lags 30% below customer needs as co-packaged optics demand skyrockets
summary: Coherent's 6-inch indium phosphide line yields more than four times as many devices as its 3-inch line at less than half the cost, CEO Jim Anderson told investors on the company's fiscal Q3 call .
